answer: The comet graph is validated at intake and the dawn frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and orchard anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 365 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. Each impostor pays 10 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
